_note: How the guns that are not a plain trigger work. Where the weapon data has the number (charge_time, fire_rate_max, fire_rate_max_time_speedup, charge_additional_damage_multiplier, the hop-up mods) it is read from there and only the rule lives here; where current Apex has moved past the data, the number here is Season 30's with its source in docs/RESEARCH_PHASE_11.md. Anything marked ours has no published number.

chargeUp._note: HAVOC: the trigger winds it up for the data's charge_time (0.42 s; the Turbocharger mod sets 0.01) before the first round; it stays wound while firing, and runs down over charge_cooldown_time after charge_cooldown_delay once you let go.

chargeShot._note: Charge Rifle (Season 30): 0.85 s after the trigger, one round. No damaging beam since Season 18.

overheat._note: L-STAR: no magazine; the mag level's shots to overheat (24/26/28/30), a forced cooldown of 1.19/1.15/1.11/1.07 s from full, cooling from 0.08 s after you stop, a full cool over the data's charge_cooldown_time (2.45 s).

adsCharge._note: 30-30 (Season 30): aiming charges it in 0.25 s; the data's charge_additional_damage_multiplier (+36%) at full; spent by the shot.

choke._note: Precision Choke (the data's hopup_energy_choke): aiming charges it over the mod's charge_time and the pellet cone closes to this fraction (ours: the data has no cone number for it).

burstCharge._note: Nemesis: the delay between bursts falls from 0.31 s to 0.19 s as it charges, +16.7% a burst fired; after 8 s without firing it loses 12.5% a second.

draw._note: Bocek (Season 30): a 0.35 s draw; at no draw 35/65 of the damage (the wiki infobox's range) and 10,000 of its 28,000 hu/s.

hopups._note: The hop-up slot, by the data's mod names (the labels are in src/config/names.ts, codenames on a public build). selectfire is ours: the switch for the Prowler's altfire, which the data has no hop-up for.

fireModes._note: B switches to the data's altfire where there is one. `needs`: only with that hop-up fitted.
